item.title: Elaine Ellington retires as Hardwick Baptist Church secretary after more than five decades - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Elaine Ellington’s life has been spent caring and loving others just like Jesus Christ instructs all of His children to do. And she’s done most of those things behind church doors.

item.title: Baldwin County grand jury declines to indict - The Union-Recorder
item.description: A Baldwin County grand jury has declined to indict a Milledgeville man on murder charges stemming from a fatal shootout outside a local restaurant last year.

item.title: RICH: Don’t it make you wanna go home? - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Not long ago, I drove home, the back way, from running errands in town.

item.title: GCSU Flannery O’Connor Institute to present screening of ‘Wise Blood’ - The Union-Recorder
item.description: The Flannery O’Connor Institute for the Humanities of Georgia College &amp; State University continues its Southern Gothic film series with a screening of John Huston’s 1979 film, “Wise Blood” in celebration of O’Connor’s 101st birthday.

item.title: Sandersville man arrested on drug charges - The Union-Recorder
item.description: A 64-year-old Sandersville man was arrested March 20 on illegal drug charges, local and state law enforcement authorities say.

item.title: CHANCEY: God takes sin seriously! Do we? - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Dr. Allan Moseley of Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary ate lunch with a friend who asked, “Have I ever told you about my name?”

item.title: Family loses everything in house fire - The Union-Recorder
item.description: A Milledgeville family is without their home after a fire destroyed it Sunday afternoon, authorities say.

item.title: Woman pleads guilty to drug trafficking charges - The Union-Recorder
item.description: A woman pleaded guilty to trafficking methamphetamine and other charges in Baldwin County Superior Court in Milledgeville on Wednesday.

item.title: Three inmates indicted on murder charges in Hancock Co. - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Three state inmates were indicted on murder charges in separate cases by a Hancock County grand jury earlier this week.

item.title: Baldwin County grand jury indicts defendants - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Several defendants were indicted on assorted criminal charges earlier this month by a Baldwin County grand jury.

item.description: Mrs. Alice Pennington should have been the spokesperson for the Milledgeville downtown merchants.

item.title: Milledgeville’s Georgia Kimble celebrates 100th birthday - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Georgia Ray “Louise” Kimble recently celebrated her 100th birthday with family and close friends.

item.title: Oak Hill boys soccer nets perfect season with CSRA championship victory - The Union-Recorder
item.description: The boys soccer team from Oak Hill Middle School finished off a remarkable season in style, capturing the CSRA Middle School Soccer Championship against TJ Elder on Monday night and completing an undefeated run.

item.title: RICH: When a woman needs a gun - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Our dear friend, Maxine, has had her share of woes. On the other hand, she has had sweet blessings. She is thinly built with delicate features, warm smiles and trademark Southern woman kindness and courtesy.

item.title: Economic development the focus of Eggs & Issues - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Economic development was the topic at the March Eggs & Issues breakfast held at Central Georgia Technical College in Milledgeville.
